repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-ediscovery
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin registered as webex.internal.ediscovery for first-party compliance clients. It creates, lists, reads, restarts, and deletes compliance reports on the eDiscovery service, reads the client config, posts the summary-download audit event, and pages report content and content containers by report UUID or remote report URL with an in-memory container cache. Payload transforms registered with webex-core encrypt report requests under a new KMS key before they are sent and decrypt report requests, activities, and containers on the way in, on behalf of each container's onBehalfOfUser, recording failures as error or warning properties instead of rejecting.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-ediscovery package entry
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports @webex/internal-plugin-encryption and @webex/internal-plugin-conversation and registers EDiscovery as internal plugin 'ediscovery' with seven payload predicates and transforms that join the module-level webex config. The named config export resolves to undefined because src/config.js has only a default export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.ediscovery runtime methods
public_interfaces.audience: first-party compliance clients and the activity decryption transform
public_interfaces.notes: The three content methods accept a report UUID or a report URL and are decorated with oneFlight. Responses arrive decrypted, or with error and warning properties on items that could not be decrypted.

public_interfaces.name: payload transforms
public_interfaces.notes: Predicates match by field name (keywords, spaceNames, emails outbound; reportRequest, activityId, containerId inbound) on every request and response of the webex instance. Implementations are in src/transforms.js.

public_interfaces.name: ediscovery configuration
public_interfaces.notes: Defaults offset 0, size 100, timeoutMs 30000, types empty; per-call options override them.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not reject an inbound transform because one field failed to decrypt.
negative_guidance.why: The downloader records error and warning properties per item; a rejection would fail a whole page of content.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not add a payload predicate on a field name other plugins use.
negative_guidance.why: Predicates run on every request and response of the webex instance once this package is imported.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not bypass getContentContainerByContainerId when decrypting activities.
negative_guidance.why: It reads the container cache first, which avoids a network call per activity.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not drop paging options from the oneFlight keys.
negative_guidance.why: Paged requests must not share a flight with another page.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the method list or the way to run tests.
negative_guidance.why: Its usage block is a placeholder and its test commands do not match package.json; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not run test:unit against a stale dist.
negative_guidance.why: The unit specs import the package by name, which resolves main (dist/index.js).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The developer confirmed no coverage gate applies; the legacy Jest config sets no threshold.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, and the behavior has a case in test/unit/spec.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists, for example registration, the array transforms, container decryption, or requestWithRetries. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap.
